claim_scope: Five prespecified stress-test settings sharing one identification topology; not five independent causal families and not neural PROBE.
rotation_rule: Four fixed folds. In rotation r, folds r,r+1,r+2,r+3 modulo four are D,S,N,E. Retain a split iff it passes all four screens. Concatenate disjoint E-fold scores per split.

learner.objective: symmetric sum of squared observed partial correlations
learner.local_minimization: bounded around every grid local minimum

screen.statistic: maximum absolute studentized residual covariance over every held-out coordinate
screen.interpretation: zero-null nonrejection gate, not equivalence or validity test

aggregation.output: median of every largest connected component; tied largest remains set-valued
aggregation.rho: 5000-draw Gaussian multiplier equivalent from pooled E-score Gram covariance; operational linking heuristic only

baselines.raw_XW: same nuisance family and N/E folds on X,I,C,all transformed proxies
baselines.oracle: same nuisance family and N/E folds on X,U,C

gates.ci: paired replicate-level absolute-error difference, two-sided t95; no multiplicity adjustment

theory_scope: rotate4 is an operational cross-fitted extension because observations used as E in one rotation enter D/S/N in others; no one-shot conditional finite-sample guarantee is claimed
